reason: This plugin is primarily an agent workflow orchestration plugin: it provides a kanban-style task board inside DSH for creating and managing cards, and a DSH-native dispatcher path that executes selected tasks with headless workers, with REST/WebSocket integration for board interaction.

summaries.zh: dsh-kanban 在 DSH 中提供可视化任务看板与卡片管理能力，并配合模型工具及本地调度器，把就绪卡片分派到 headless worker 执行。
summaries.en: dsh-kanban adds a web-based task board inside DSH with card management tools and model actions, and can dispatch ready cards to a local DSH headless worker flow for execution.

capabilities: Provides card lifecycle management via DSH model tools for kanban boards/tasks
Dispatches selected cards to DSH headless workers using a configurable command
Serves board UI and task APIs with live event updates through WebSocket

reasons.code: README describes a 9-column kanban board with card operations, multi-board support, diagnostics, and live event streaming in a DSH UI context.
README lists explicit model tools (create/get/update/comment/link/unlink/delete/dispatch) and a DSH-native dispatcher for running cards.
Repository package metadata defines a web platform client plugin bundle and DSH bundle patching, indicating integration into the host application runtime.
